description: Search the Georgia Standards of Excellence by topic, with optional filters. Returns matching standards as `items` (each: `code`, `subject`, `grades`, `strand_code`, `strand_name`, `hs_course`, `statement`, plus optional `notes` and `path`). When enrichment is on, the response also carries `alds` (achievement-level descriptions per standard), `assessment_coverage` (Milestones claim, target, approx_points, sub_codes, qualifier), and `assessment_metadata` keyed by assessment_id (Depth of Knowledge split, item-type design); the server instructions explain how to read points, qualifiers, and levels. If `dropped_strand` is set, the strand filter matched nothing and the results span the whole subject. `truncated` means more matches may exist than `limit` allowed. Enrichment is automatic for small result sets (8 standards or fewer) and off for larger ones unless `include_enrichment` is true. If the query itself contains a standard code (e.g. 'what is 5.NR.1?'), the search becomes a direct code lookup and the other filters are ignored; lookup_standards_by_code is the direct route for known codes. Matches the words of the standards in English or Spanish, plus some everyday phrases ('times tables'); the standards' own words work best.

course.description: Optional high-school course, e.g. 'algebra i', 'biology', 'us history' (describe_vocabulary lists them).
course.title: Course

grade.description: One grade: 'K' (or 'KG') or '01' through '12'. '1' through '9' also work. Do not combine with grade_set.
grade.title: Grade

grade_set.description: Several grades at once, e.g. ['03', '04', '05']. Do not combine with grade.
grade_set.title: Grade Set

include_enrichment.description: true attaches achievement levels and Milestones coverage to every result; false never does; omit for automatic.
include_enrichment.title: Include Enrichment

limit.description: Most rows to return, 1 to 100. Default: 40 when narrowed by grade, grade_set, or course; 20 otherwise.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Topic words to search for, e.g. 'adding fractions with unlike denominators'.
query.title: Query

strand_code.description: Optional strand, by code ('NR') or name ('Numerical Reasoning'). describe_vocabulary lists the strands for each subject.
strand_code.title: Strand Code

name: search_standards
title: Search Standards
